I highly recommend using a varnish of some sort to coat the pages. Since this is a precious item, I would spend some time researching the best one. Go to a store that specializes in scrap-booking (Michael's if you're in the USA) and talk to the associates about the materials you are trying to preserve. They will likely suggest something like a lightweight poly acrylic or a polyurethane varnish, but you will see different hardness and potentially bleeding from the different products, so definitely test them on small areas before mass applying. Alternatively, and perhaps more simply, you could use transparent contact paper to essentially laminate the pages. Regardless you will probably end up with a gloss surface, so I hope you're okay with that.
